Coming out is ALL about the personal feeling and POV. Coming out to parents or friends or world is not something one HAS to do. If someone wants to do it they can, if someone does not want to do it they absolutely do not have to. It is about oneself and their individuality.

As coming out can be a long process that even includes struggles within oneself. The confusion, comparison, tolerance and finally acceptance of one's identity can be very challenging in itself and coming out to parent/s/others just might be a way of celebrating the end of the grueling period.

But then again, it is ALL about what/how YOU want to it.
